name: Slumbering Court
description: This great hall stood when Seirai Island neither had the name it has now, nor had it yet been stained with the color of thunder. The scenery within will probably never change, either.

tabs.name: Domain of Blessing: Necropolis I
tabs.description:
This masterless mansion has become the haunting ground of monsters from the rift.
Those who can wield the eternal lightning to conquer this trial will obtain the artifacts within.
